priorities.change: Coverage-oriented prompt, factory-wide public coverage digest and direct execution/call feedback
rules: Group all families in fixed source order; no top-k, scoring or suggested assignments.
Use only public observations and already observed execution history.
Separate ready backlog, future operation status and route uncertainty; a conditional boolean is not a complete risk taxonomy.
Validate facts against current context; old exact facts stay historical unless dependency validity is established.
No minimum task quota, artificial holds, suppressed demand or changed trigger timing.

priorities.change: Read-only candidate coverage diagnostics based on selected tasks and public nominal forecasts
rules: Do not choose jobs, machines, batches or order.
Label nominal estimates; never simulate hidden RNG outcomes for model feedback.
Treat coverage diagnostics as advisory; legality and production quality remain primary.

priorities.change: Versioned preservation of original earliest-start lower bounds for retained pending tasks
rules: Retain exact original not_before when it is a lower bound rather than a deadline.
Require original task identity and explicit keep, actual readiness, unchanged freezes and no re-dispatch.
Do not silently clamp timestamps or alter order.
Compare separately because this expands accepted plan revisions; apply common semantics across arms.

priorities.change: Optional explicitly model-authorized atomic propose-and-commit action
rules: The model must explicitly request conditional commit of its exact proposal.
Compile and validate; commit only on success with revision/context check and an idempotent request ID.
Failure has no physical effect. No alternative selection, repair or generated schedule.
Separate this protocol experiment from coverage improvements to measure its contribution.

evaluation.states: Three saved states spanning startup, multi-task queues and the recent singleton phase; compare identical public context and identical declared inherited model memory within each pair.
variants: same guidance plus public coverage context and feedback
evaluation.model: Keep current B model and reasoning effort fixed.
evaluation.window_note: An exploratory nominal target, not a guaranteed advancement or a minimum task quota.
keep_fixed: model budget and stop rules within each paired comparison
evaluation.success: Reduce model resource consumption at comparable legality, service and production quality; report failures, unknown usage and full costs. No savings percentage is asserted before measurement.

focused_existing_tests.meaning: Confirms existing mechanics only, not performance of the proposed prompt or context.
